ITEM 1 | Dark green leafy greens with thin stems and lobed, ruffled leaf edges, glossy with a light sheen, piled loosely in the right half of a square white plate, covering roughly 40% of the plate with a height of about 2-3 cm; some leaves lie flat, others stand up in a loose mound, with a few stalks radiating outward | 60

ITEM 2 | Small brown-tan lentil-like grains, matte and slightly glistening, coated with browned caramelized bits and bits of diced onion-like pieces, forming a crumbly cluster about 8 cm across and 1-1.5 cm high on the left-center of the plate, mixed among the greens at the lower-left edge | 70

ITEM 3 | Light golden-brown glossy film with darker caramelized flecks, spread thinly among the lentil cluster and greens, appearing oily and sticky, covering roughly 5% of the plate | 5

ITEM 4 | Small scattered pale-brown and reddish-brown chopped bits, about 0.5-1 cm each, dry-looking and slightly browned, scattered around the lentil cluster and onto the greens | 5
